description: I’m an Ecuadorian businessman, entrepreneur, and technology enthusiast passionate about AI, space exploration, and innovation. I bring skills in data analysis, strategic planning, and project management. At VELKARIS, our mission is to transform NASA’s open data into groundbreaking solutions. We’re seeking developers, AI engineers, data scientists, designers, and creative thinkers ready to innovate, collaborate, and compete globally. Join us to push boundaries and build the future!
